blocks.text: 🪝 RBI Retains Floating Rate Savings Bonds (FRSB 2020) Interest Rate at 8.05%. Key development for Banking & General Awareness.

items: Maintains 0.35% premium over National Savings Certificate (NSC) 7.7% benchmark.
FRSB Coupon Rate: 8.05% per annum for July 1 to Dec 31, 2026 (payable Jan 1, 2027).
Benchmark Formula: FRSB rate = NSC rate (7.70%) + 0.35% spread.
FRSB interest rate (8.05%) vs NSC benchmark rate (7.70%).
